method: Invented Markdown seeded with POST /documents in the separate restored QA workspace. Opened in latest packaged Noye Phase8 QA through native UI, Preview, Export PDF, macOS save panel. No programmatic PDF authoring substituted for export.

before.finding: Image heading alone on page 5; figure starts on page 6. All 40 table rows and 40 code lines retained.

fixed.visual_review: All seven full-page renders inspected. Image heading, whole vector image and caption on page 6; no app chrome, missing rows, clipped text or unreadable Korean observed. All table row/end markers, code begin/end markers, list items and final sentinel retained after diagnostic whitespace normalization.
fixed.limitations: Continuation table header is not repeated. Long code can wrap and split across pages. This does not certify arbitrary wide tables, external images, every printer or other OS.

save_panel.first_before: Initial default Save disabled; filename edit + Tab enabled it. Cause was not isolated.
save_panel.repeat_before: Save enabled with default name without filename edits; cancelled and observed PDF export cancelled.
save_panel.fresh_fixed_app: First PDF panel after relaunch had Save enabled immediately; saved default filename without editing or changing its remembered QA directory. Earlier failure retained; one success does not certify every remembered location.

inspection_method: MuPDF text + per-page PNG, reviewed all pages. Direct substring initially misclassified every code end as missing because it wrapped as END newline -C001; whitespace-normalized checks and visual review confirmed retained text. Literal Markdown hash is separate from normalized PDF diagnostics.
